title: Taylor secretly chief scientist of UAP Task Force

tellings.quote: unbeknownst to us, he gets called into meetings in Washington, D.C. and he's called in to be the chief scientist of the UAP Task Force.

plain: Around 2020, a man named Travis Taylor, who worked with the team at a property called Skinwalker Ranch, was quietly called into meetings in Washington and made chief scientist of the UAP Task Force. That was a Pentagon group set up to look into UAP, "unidentified anomalous phenomena", the newer official word for UFOs. The ranch's owner tells Michels this from the inside, saying the team had no idea at the time ("unbeknownst to us"). If true, it means someone from the ranch's own research was working at the heart of the government's UFO effort.
